theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  classical
  have h_one : ∀ A : Set S, A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A
    by_contra! h
    obtain ⟨hA, hAc⟩ := h
    obtain ⟨U, hU, hAU⟩ := hPS ⟨hA, by tauto⟩
    obtain ⟨V, hV, hAV⟩ := hPS ⟨hAc, by tauto⟩
    have h₃ : U ∩ V ≠ ∅ := hPP U hU V hV
    obtain x hx := h₃
    have hxA : x ∈ A := by rwa [mem_compl] at hAV
    have hxAc : x ∈ Aᶜ := by rwa [mem_compl] at hAU
    contradiction
  have h_neither : ∀ A : Set S, ¬(A ∈ P ∧ Aᶜ ∈ P) := by
    intro A h
    have h₁ : A ∩ Aᶜ = ∅ := by ext x; simp
    have h₂ : A ∩ Aᶜ ≠ ∅ := hPP A h.1 Aᶜ h.2
    contradiction
  have h_card : P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) := by
    have h₁ : (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card = P.card + (Finset.univ \ P).card := by
      simp [Finset.card_union_add_card_inter, Finset.disjoint_right_mem_inter, Finset.disjoint_iff_inter_eq_empty]
      <;> simp_all
      <;> tauto
    have h₂ : (Finset.univ \ P).card = P.card := by
      apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
      <;> simp_all [Finset.mem_compl, Finset.mem_univ]
      <;> tauto
    rw [h₁, h₂]
    have h₃ : (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
      simp [Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set]
    rw [h₃] at *
    omega
  exact h_card
